steps: Open / and land on /web marketing home with hero, nav, blog cards, publication band, footer
Navigate TripIt / TripIt Pro / How It Works / Pricing / SAP Concur from the primary nav
Open the language menu from the EN control and see the locale entries
On mobile, open the hamburger menu and reach the same destinations
Follow footer links to Security, Blog, Traveler Resource Center, and legal pages
Open /account/login and see logo, Email Address and Password floating-label fields, Keep me signed in, Forgot password?, Sign In, Google SSO, Create one link, legal footer
Open /account/create and see Email Address, Password with 'At least 15 characters. Cannot be an email.' helper, Home City, user-agreement checkbox, Create an Account, Google SSO
Open /account/forgotPassword and see the reset-request form
Type an invalid email on login and blur: field label turns red and 'Please use a valid email address.' appears without any request being sent
Submit the create-account form with a fresh email, 15+ char non-email password, home city, and accepted agreement
Receive the registration mail (purpose=registration) in the active outbox with a secret verification code
Complete verification and land signed in with a server-issued __Host session cookie
The account and traveler profile rows exist; a welcome notification is recorded
Submit with an already-registered email, a short password, an email-shaped password, or an unchecked agreement
The form re-renders with source-matching field-level errors; no account row is created
Enter a wrong verification code and see the failure state
Request a fresh code; the old challenge is invalidated and the new one verifies successfully
Submit valid credentials for traveler@example.com on /account/login
A server session row is created and the __Host-websitebench-tripit-session cookie is set
The browser lands on the trips list with the seeded Upcoming trips visible
Submit a wrong password
See the source-matching generic error without account-existence disclosure; no session is created
After a failed attempt, resubmit with correct credentials and sign in successfully
Submit the forgot-password form for traveler@example.com
A password-reset mail (purpose=password-reset) with a secret code is issued to the active outbox
The response does not disclose whether the address exists
Open the reset flow with the emailed code, set a new 15+ char password
Old sessions are revoked; signing in with the new password succeeds and with the old one fails
Attempt the reset with a wrong or expired code and see the failure state; the password is unchanged
Sign out from the account menu; the session row is invalidated and protected routes redirect to sign-in
Open the trips list as traveler@example.com
Upcoming shows New York, Kyoto Autumn, Lisbon Getaway ordered by start date under the frozen clock 2026-08-04
Past shows Chicago Sprint; Unfiled shows the seeded unfiled restaurant item
Empty-state copy renders when a tab has no rows (verified via the second account's tabs)
Create a trip with name, destination, start and end dates
The trip appears in the correct tab position; refresh and server restart preserve it
Submit with end date before start date or a blank destination and see field-level errors; no row is created
Edit the Kyoto trip's dates and name; the list resorts accordingly and the change persists
Delete a trip through its confirmation dialog; contained plans are removed with it; cancel leaves everything intact
Merge two overlapping trips; plans re-home to the surviving trip, the duplicate is removed, and the action is idempotent
Open the seeded New York trip (2027-05-22..27) and choose Add a hotel
Type 'Hilton' and pick 'New York Hilton Midtown' from the typeahead
Enter check-in May 23 and check-out May 26; the datepicker defaults resolve to 2027 from the trip window
Enter confirmation number 4482210417 and save through the source-matching loading and success states
The reservation joins the existing trip (never a new trip) in correct chronological position
It survives refresh and server restart; it can be edited, moved, and deleted
Resubmitting the same form and importing fixture::hilton-midtown-confirmation do not create duplicates
other@example.com cannot see or modify it (403/404 without existence disclosure)
Double-submit the hotel form (double click / resubmit after back); exactly one lodging row exists afterwards
From a trip, add one plan of each of the 12 types: air, lodging, car, rail, transport, cruise, restaurant, meeting, activity, map, directions, note
Each type's form shows its registered field set, validation timing, defaults, and success feedback
Each saved plan renders its type-specific detail view and sits in correct timeline order (lodging expands to check-in/check-out rows, car to pick-up/drop-off rows)
Edit a plan's times and fields; the timeline reorders deterministically
Move a plan to another trip and back; delete it via its confirmation flow
Submit a plan form with end before start or missing required fields and see field-level errors; nothing is saved
Inject fixture::hilton-midtown-confirmation through the simulator inbox
The message parses to a lodging plan that joins the New York trip by date overlap
An import receipt business mail is enqueued and the import history row shows parse_status=parsed
Import the United itinerary (routes to Unfiled), then the United change fixture: the existing plan updates in place (parse_status=updated)
Import the Marriott confirmation then its cancellation: the plan is marked canceled with the source-matching canceled presentation
Re-inject an already-imported fixture; the fingerprint matches, parse_status=duplicate, and no second plan is created
Inject fixture::newsletter-unparseable; no plan is created and the visible unparseable failure state matches the frozen contract
Invite other@example.com to the New York trip as viewer; a share-invite business mail is enqueued
The invitee accepts through the tokenized link and sees the trip read-only, with sensitive fields (confirmation numbers) hidden unless show_sensitive is granted
Change the share role to editor and verify the invitee can now edit plans
Revoke the share; the invitee immediately loses access (403/404 without existence disclosure)
other@example.com requests traveler's trip and plan URLs without a share and receives 403/404 with no existence disclosure; mutation attempts change nothing
Upload a PDF and an image to a plan; preview and download them; delete one
Documents persist across restart as BLOB rows and reset restores the single seeded document
Upload a file beyond the size limit and see the source-matching error; no row is created
Open the print view of the New York trip; the chronological itinerary renders in the print layout
Enable the calendar feed; a tokenized ICS URL is issued (token stored only as digest)
Fetching the feed returns deterministic VEVENT rows for the seeded plans; revoking the token invalidates the URL
Edit profile name and home city; toggle notification settings; changes persist and render back
Start the TripIt Pro upgrade from the upsell surface
Complete checkout through the payment adapter (local-sandbox approved locally; stripe-test checkout on review profiles)
The verified webhook activates exactly one pro_subscription row; a pro-receipt business mail is enqueued
Pro-gated features unlock; status shows in account settings
A declined scenario shows the source-matching failure state and leaves no subscription
A retryable scenario succeeds on the second attempt with exactly one active subscription
Cancel the subscription; entitlements remain until period end per the frozen copy, then lapse; duplicate webhooks never re-activate

Flight alerts, gate/terminal, alternate flights, fare tracking, baggage, Go Now, airport guidance, guides, loyalty balances, and passport reminders render from deterministic local fixtures keyed by the frozen clock
Free-tier users see the source-matching upsell interstitials instead
POST /__admin/reset with the admin token restores the exact seed manifest state (probe seed-reset.exact-reseed); repeat is idempotent (seed-reset.idempotent-repeat)
Committed mutations survive a full process restart (probe seed-reset.restart-round-trip); the migration journals hold exactly the manifest's physical rows
